title: Opening
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-endings/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
You're late. Again.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The city kept me up.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
The city doesn't pay rent. The landlord came by twice.
<<speaker, Detective>>
How much do we have?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Enough for the phone bill or the light bill. Pick one.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Keep the phone. I can work in the dark.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Good. Because the phone rang at eight. Vivian Ash.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The Vivian Ash? Hill money?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Someone stole her gem last night. The Crimson Heart. She wants us on it today.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Why us?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
She asked for someone discreet. I think she meant cheap.
And there's a man on the stairs who says he's your lawyer.
<<speaker, Detective>>
I don't have a lawyer.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
He says that's your problem. He's been knocking for ten minutes.
<<character, hide, secretary>>
<<character, show, jimmy, x = 680>>
<<speaker>>
The door opens. A man in a bright checked suit is already holding out a business card.
<<speaker, Jimmy>>
First consultation is free. Second one is also free. I'm running a promotion.
Before the cops tell you anything about me, you hear it from me. I have something you need and nothing I want to keep.
[[Hear him out|HearHimOut]]
[[Throw him out|ThrowHimOut]]

title: HearHimOut
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-endings/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, jimmy, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Jimmy>>
Pawn ticket. Kessler Loans on Dock Street, number 4471, made out to Mrs. V. Ash.
She pawned the Crimson Heart herself yesterday morning. I phoned ahead for her. I thought it was a short loan for a lady.
Last night she gave me the box, the key and this ticket to get rid of. Two hours later she called the police.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Yesterday morning. Funny time to pawn a gem that was stolen last night.
<<speaker, Jimmy>>
And my card is on her hall table. I'm a lawyer. I know when someone is setting me up.
<<character, hide, jimmy>>
<<speaker>>
Jimmy leaves. A minute later Vivian Ash walks in without knocking.
<<jump, VivianOffer>>

title: ThrowHimOut
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-endings/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, jimmy, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
Out. I can't afford a lawyer.
<<character, hide, jimmy>>
<<speaker>>
Jimmy leaves a card on the desk and goes. Five minutes later the phone rings.
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
It's the commissioner. For you.
<<speaker, "Commissioner Briggs">>
The lawyer was seen going into your building. Where is he now?
Nine o'clock. After that it's my case and I close it my way.
[[Give Briggs the lawyer|ClosedByNine]]
[[Go after Jimmy|GoAfterJimmy]]

title: GoAfterJimmy
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-endings/assets/images/office_exterior.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 300, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, jimmy, x = 680>>
<<speaker>>
Jimmy is still on the sidewalk, handing a card to a man at the bus stop.
<<speaker, Jimmy>>
Changed your mind? Smart. Here.
Pawn ticket. Kessler Loans on Dock Street, number 4471. Mrs. Ash pawned the gem herself yesterday morning.
I arranged the loan. She arranged for my card to be on her hall table.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Yesterday morning. Funny time to pawn a gem that was stolen last night.
<<character, hide, jimmy>>
<<speaker>>
Back upstairs, Vivian Ash is waiting in the client chair.
<<jump, VivianOffer>>

title: VivianOffer
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-endings/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, "Vivian Ash">>
I asked for someone discreet. You look wonderfully discreet.
Two hundred for you, darling, if that lawyer is in a cell by tonight.
[[Take her money|PaidInFull]]
[[Show her the ticket|PawnTicket]]

title: PawnTicket
body:
<<ending, pawnTicket>>
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-endings/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
Briggs got the ticket. Kessler got a visit. The Crimson Heart went back to the insurance company.
Mrs. Ash got charged. Jimmy got a thank-you he'll frame. We got a reward big enough for the rent.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Three months paid. Don't get used to it.

title: PaidInFull
body:
<<ending, paidInFull>>
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-endings/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
I took her money. Briggs took Jimmy. The ticket went in my bottom drawer.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
The rent is paid. You haven't said a word since.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Some mornings the city keeps me up. Now I know why.

title: ClosedByNine
body:
<<ending, closedByNine>>
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-endings/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
Briggs had his lawyer at nine and his headline at ten.
They let Jimmy go a week later for lack of evidence. He sent me a bill for his time.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Mrs. Ash sent flowers. And somewhere on Dock Street a red stone is still waiting.
